crons.description:
Weekly robotics reading digest — top 3 articles. SEND result to user via send_owner_message.

SOURCES to check (in priority order):
1. Weekly Robotics: browse https://weeklyrobotics.com — grab latest issue, find top picks
2. IEEE Spectrum Robotics: browse https://spectrum.ieee.org/topic/robotics — articles from last 7 days
3. BAIR Blog: browse https://bair.berkeley.edu/blog — posts from last 7 days
4. Boston Dynamics blog: browse https://bostondynamics.com/blog — latest posts
5. Figure AI news: browse https://figure.ai/news — latest posts
6. NVIDIA Robotics blog: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/category/robotics/ — last 7 days
7. Agility Robotics: https://agilityrobotics.com/blog

DEDUP: Read /data/robotics_sent.json (list of sent URLs). Skip any URL already in this list.

SELECTION RULES:
- Pick TOP 3 articles from last 7 days across all sources
- Prioritize: technical depth, actual deployments, hardware insights, sim-to-real, manipulation research
- Skip: press releases, funding-only news, pure demos with no substance
- Robot Report excluded (user gets it via email) UNLESS truly exceptional
- If fewer than 3 fresh articles found — send what exists (1-2 is fine), skip week entirely if nothing

FORMAT for send_owner_message:
Robotics week {ISO week}

1. **[Article Title]** — {Source}
   {1-2 sentences: what is technically interesting, why it matters}
   {URL}

AFTER SENDING: Append sent URLs to /data/robotics_sent.json (create if missing).

crons.description:
Spartak Moscow match monitor — biweekly schedule report.

Use the check_spartak_matches tool (send_telegram=true) to fetch and send upcoming Spartak Moscow matches to the user.

The tool will:
- Scrape https://www.sports.ru/football/club/spartak/calendar/
- Show upcoming home and away matches
- Send the formatted message directly to Telegram

SILENT: do NOT send any progress messages. Just call check_spartak_matches and finish.
Run run_data_cleanup to remove stale files from /data/ — temp files, old task results (>14d), orphan scripts, stale logs.

Daily scratchpad refresh + health check + USER_CONTEXT update. ALWAYS runs — silent unless a problem is found.

STEP 1 — HEALTH CHECK
Read /data/memory/scratchpad.md. Checks:
1. File exists and is readable
2. Total character count > 200 (not trivially populated)
3. Contains at least one meaningful section with real content (non-empty bullet line or paragraph >50 chars)

Definition of HEALTHY: char count > 200 AND at least one non-empty bullet line (starts with - or *) or paragraph with >50 chars.

If ANY check fails → call send_owner_message with:
  ⚠️ Scratchpad health check failed
  - Which check failed
  - Current scratchpad character count
  - First 200 chars of content

STEP 2 — REFRESH LIVE DATA (always, even if healthy)
Read /data/crons.json and note fire_count and last_fired_at for each cron.
Current budget and UTC time are in your ## Runtime context section.
DO NOT read any state files (state/state.json, state.json, state/drive_state.json, etc.) — all needed data is already in the runtime context above.

Call update_scratchpad with the FULL updated content. Preserve all non-volatile sections verbatim (GitHub Token Fix notes, Notes section, User Context section). Only update these dynamic sections:

UpdatedAt: replace with current UTC time

## Status
Rewrite all bullet lines with fresh values:
- Gmail scanner: RUNNING (hourly cron, last fired {last_fired_at for id=8e63b12c from crons.json}, fire_count={fire_count})
- GitHub token: FIXED AND VERIFIED — load_dotenv(override=True) patch works, gh auth confirms login
- git remote: working, ls-remote responds correctly
- All crons running: AI Conferences (Mon 07:00 UTC), Robotics Digest (Wed 05:00 UTC), Spartak monitor (1st+15th 10:00 MSK), Gmail scanner (hourly)
- ⏸️ Spartak tickets monitor: paused (user requested)
- 💰 Budget: {remaining_usd from runtime context} remaining ({total_usd} total)
- ✈️ User travel: [reflect current/upcoming travel from USER_CONTEXT.md or leave blank if none]
- 🇷🇺 Russia days: [update if known, otherwise preserve last value]
- 🇪🇺 Schengen: [update if known, otherwise preserve last value]

## Health Invariants
Rewrite with current values:
- ✅ GitHub token: FIXED AND WORKING
- ✅ Budget: {remaining_usd} remaining
- ✅ No high-cost tasks
- ✅ No duplicate processing

## Runtime
Rewrite with current values:
UTC: {current UTC from runtime context}
Budget remaining: {remaining_usd} / {total_usd}

STEP 3 — UPDATE USER_CONTEXT.md (always)
Read the current /data/memory/USER_CONTEXT.md.
Update it to reflect any changes since the last run. Keep it under 1000 characters. Focus on:
- Current/upcoming travel (check flights.json for next bookings if relevant)
- Budget status (remaining_usd from runtime context)
- Days tracker: Schengen and Russia day counts if they've changed
- Remove outdated items (past trips, past deadlines)
- Preserve stable facts (language, preferences, VPS IP, Spartak interest, ICML registration)

Call update_user_context with the refreshed content.

SILENT — do NOT send any message if everything is healthy and all updates succeed.
